disclaimer: Single live baseline of A4 NLQ intent classification (Ollama JSON → parseNlqIntent → lexical gate) on the frozen 34-question gold corpus. Not general conversational AI accuracy, not chatbot quality, not RBAC/DB answer correctness. Raw model intent and full-pipeline disposition are reported separately. Invalid-parameter items (paramsValid=false) are excluded from the three-class pipeline confusion matrix and counted under operational rejection instead.

sourceArtifact.note: This summary copies headline metrics from that timestamped file. It does not re-score under later evaluator reporting schemas.

sampleCounts.note: Original artifact sets complete=true meaning corpus traversal finished without abort. One question timed out; accuracy denominators use 33 (raw/ops) or 30 (confusion), not 34.

rawSemanticIntentAgreement.definition: Model JSON intent string equals gold semantic intent; excludes transport_error rows.

operationalSuccess.definition: For paramsValid=false: pipeline unsupported. Else: pipeline disposition matches gold intent class. Excludes transport_error.

pipelineConfusion3Class.definition: Gold intent vs pipeline predicted class after parse+gate. Excludes paramsValid=false (G25–G27). Excludes transport_error (G01).

perClass.note: Precision/recall/F1 derived from the recorded confusion matrix (not a separate field in the original artifact).

unsupportedRejection.falseAcceptIdsSource: Per-question rows in the original artifact (metrics block records count only).

paramAccuracyGivenAcceptedWindow.definition: Among valid window questions accepted as count_actions_window, parsed days/agentId match gold.

lexicalGateFalseNegatives.observation: Raw model intent matched gold supported intent; pipeline disposition was unsupported (gate FN probes).
lexicalGateFalseNegatives.note: These rows reduce full-pipeline accuracy; they are not raw-intent failures.

nonTransport.source: Derived: mean of questions[].latencyMs where pipelineStatus !== transport_error.

A4-G01.interpretation: First-item timeout. Cold start / model load is a plausible explanation but was not instrumented or confirmed in this run.

limitations: Single live trial (n=1 run); no multi-seed or multi-model replication.
Small frozen benchmark (34 questions); not a general NLP or chatbot benchmark.
Full-pipeline metrics include lexical-gate effects; gate probes G32–G34 are intentional FN cases.
G01 transport miss excludes one gold pending item from confusion and from raw/ops denominators.
Does not measure grounded answer correctness, RBAC, or Graduated Trust dispatch.
Homelab Ollama endpoint details are intentionally omitted from this summary.

reproduction.requires: Configured Ollama endpoint env + model qwen2.5:1.5b available; no DB required for this intent-only eval.
reproduction.caution: A new run produces a new timestamped artifact. Do not overwrite or replace the baseline stamp cited in sourceArtifact.path when citing these numbers.
